_meta.description: Per-row scores on one common factor behind revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes on experiment.pulse via ATTR_FACTOR_SCORE, each from an inline fit with MAT_FACTOR's knobs (the same loadings, order and sign as MAT_FACTOR on the same rows). f1_regression is the regression (Thurstone) score of the default minres fit; f1_bartlett the Bartlett score of a maximum-likelihood fit (params.extraction "ml"). session_minutes shares almost nothing with the revenue pair, so this is a poor one-factor battery and the warnings say so: neither fit converges within its iteration cap (PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_CONVERGED, fit scope, the scores use the last iterate), and the minres fit is a Heywood case (revenue's uniqueness below 0, PULSE_MATRIX_HEYWOOD), so its regression scores are improper, with a spread well above 1. The ML fit keeps every uniqueness positive: its Bartlett scores average about 0 on both arms with a standard deviation near 1. On a longer battery set params.factors and a rotation (two factors need at least five members). The fit is cohort-wide, never per treatment; grouping runs the request buffered.
_meta.name: attr_factor_score
